title: OppFi to present at Stephens Investment Conference
summary: OppFi Inc. (NYSE: OPFI) ("OppFi" or the "Company"), a tech-enabled digital finance platform that partners with banks to offer financial products and services to everyday Americans, announced that Pam Johnson, CFO, will present at the Stephens Annual Investment Conference in Nashville, TN, on November 19 at 1:00 p.m. CT/2:00 p.m. ET. A video webcast of the presentation will be available here or on the Company's website investors.oppfi.com . The webcast will be archived on the company's website for 90 days following the event. About OppFi OppFi (NYSE: OPFI) is a tech-enabled digital finance platform that partners with banks to offer financial products and services to everyday Americans. Through this transparent and responsible platform, which emphasizes financial inclusion and exceptional customer experience, the Company assists consumers who are underserved by traditional financing options in building improved financial health.
